mapper.select: SELECT p.id as post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.content_format, p.word_count, p.type, p.status, p.is_top, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.images, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p_stats.total_posts, p_stats.published_posts, p_stats.draft_posts, p_stats.reviewing_posts, p_stats.locked_posts, p_stats.total_comments, p_stats.total_likes, p_stats.total_views, p_stats.total_words, f_stats.total_followers, f_stats.new_followers, f_stats.interactive_followers FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewing_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS locked_posts, COALESCE(SUM(comment_count), 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS total_likes, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) AS total_words FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ) p_stats CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_followers, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_followers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uf.follower_id) FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN post p ON uf.follower_id = p.user_id WHERE uf.followee_id = #{userId} AND (p.comment_count > 0 OR p.like_count > 0)) AS interactive_followers FROM user_follow WHERE followee_id = #{userId} ) f_stats

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
AND status = 0
AND status != 0
AND status = #{status}

SELECT p.id as post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.content_format, p.word_count, p.type, p.status, p.is_top, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.images, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id as post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.content_format, p.word_count, p.type, p.status, p.is_top, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.images, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM post current_post INNER JOIN post p ON p.id != current_post.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE current_post.id = #{postId} AND current_post.is_deleted = 0 AND current_post.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY ( CASE WHEN p.type = current_post.type THEN 45 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN p.user_id = current_post.user_id THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', current_post.title, '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END ) DESC, p.is_top DESC, p.view_count DESC, p.comment_count DESC, p.like_count DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
